prompts: Fix view_state(catalog, version, selected_hazard=None) in view.py. Each version has its own assets mapping hazard names to hrefs. Return available_hazards sorted from that version only, selected_hazard preserved only if it exists there, and data_url from the selected hazard or None. Do not display a globally known hazard as available when this version has not computed it.
Handle switching from one version to another in the same session: a formerly valid hazard must clear when absent in the new version, while a shared hazard keeps the new version’s URL.
A version with no assets should yield an empty list, selected_hazard=None and data_url=None. Verify switching and empty coverage without inventing default assets.

checks.name: version-scoped-options-and-values

rubric: Bind options, selection validity and displayed data to the selected version’s actual assets. Preserve a valid selection across switches but clear unavailable data. Do not claim computed coverage merely because another version has it or invent fallback assets.
provenance: codex-22-derive-visible-options-from-the-selected-version; sanitized incident reconstruction; no historical pre-error workspace recovered. Additional turns and the compaction boundary are designed extensions.
